meta.name: LESTARI — Hutan & Hikayat
meta.source: Derived from the brief's written descriptions of three reference apps (no image files were supplied) and adapted into an original identity. Format: zanwei/design-dna schema.
references_described: Playful learning app: colourful 3D characters, rounded progress cards, purple accents, engaging welcome screen
Clean educational mobile app: discovery cards, progress indicators, subject tiles, bottom navigation
Dark gamified app: dark backgrounds, bright green progress, streaks, challenges, achievements
extracted_principles: One clear primary action per screen, in a single saturated accent
Chunky, friendly, pressable controls with generous touch targets
Progress expressed as real numbers and short bars, never decoration
A dark 'challenge' surface with a bright green indicator for the daily game
A character guide that appears at moments of welcome, emptiness and celebration

color.rule: Colour carries meaning (action, correct, wrong, reward); chrome stays paper and ink.

design_style.aesthetic: Warm manuscript paper meets rainforest play: literary serif sayings on a modern, tactile app
design_style.visual_language: Flat surfaces, warm rules, one violet, a hornbill guide
design_style.composition: Type-led stats instead of tiles; one dominant block per screen; the dark challenge panel as the counterweight
design_style.imagery: Original SVG mascot (Bayu the hornbill) and simple canopy silhouettes; no stock images
design_style.interaction_feel: Pressable, quick, forgiving; feedback is immediate and encouraging
design_style.brand_voice_in_ui: Friendly Bahasa Melayu, second person (kamu), never shaming: 'Hampir tepat! Cuba fahami maksudnya sekali lagi.'

visual_effects.overview: Restrained. One authored moment per screen; everything respects prefers-reduced-motion.
visual_effects.particle_systems: React Bits ClickSpark bursts on correct answers and saves (canvas over real HTML controls)
visual_effects.3d_elements: CSS 3D flip on flashcards only; no WebGL
visual_effects.text_effects: GSAP staggered line entrance on the welcome tagline; GSAP count-up on quiz scores
visual_effects.glassmorphism_neumorphism: none (removed after Hallmark sloplint flagged header blur)
visual_effects.svg_animations: GSAP timeline moves Bayu's head and wing on welcome and achievement moments
visual_effects.composite_notes: Evaluated and declined: Scroll World (needs paid Higgsfield video generation), Canvas UI and Three.js scenes (GPU cost on student devices for little learning value).
